title: Pilot hero
description: A deep aubergine hero with a faint ledger grid on its right side and a violet glow in the bottom corner: a star rating row, a big semibold two-line headline, a wide product media slot, a butter-yellow pill with a pink mono link, then a mono 'trusted by' label over a row of customer names (some with a pink handwritten 'case study' tag). Left-aligned on phones, centred on desktop.
notes: the band is the theme's secondary colour (aubergine in pilot-theme) with secondary-foreground text
the grid lines and glow are CSS backgrounds; the product media is a placeholder until filled
name: pilot-hero

props.name: rating
props.type: { score: string; count: string; stars?: number; source: string; }
props.description: the review score row above the headline; leave out to hide it

props.name: title
props.description: the headline; \n sets the desktop line break

props.name: lede
props.description: an optional paragraph under the headline

props.name: link
props.description: a pink uppercase mono link beside the pill

props.name: media
props.description: the product picture (a screenshot composite); a placeholder when empty

props.name: logosLabel
props.description: the mono line over the customer names
